limitation: Cross-fitting isolates calibration fitting, not earlier epoch/rate selection. This reused validation cohort is not an independent test. Saved FP32 probabilities replace logits; flooring loses information below 1e-15.

plan.assessment: Shared group-disjoint five-fold cross-fitting on existing validation; exploratory because model/epoch selection already used this cohort. Pool out-of-fold predictions per run, then mean/sample SD across seeds. No best-seed selection or ensemble.
plan.full_validation_fit: Save one temperature per model/seed for future locked evaluation. Do not use its in-sample metrics as evidence of improvement.
